discovered_tools.description:
Submit the current deliverable for grading.

Snapshots the deliverable directory right now (later edits do not affect this
submission) and starts grading it on the public validation split. Returns at
once with a submission id. One submission is graded at a time: check `result`
and submit again once the previous submission has its score. `note` is a short
description of what changed.
discovered_tools.name: submit

discovered_tools.description:
The current state of a submission: queued, grading, or graded with its
validation score and grader output. Returns immediately.
discovered_tools.name: result

discovered_tools.description:
Submission count, whether one is being graded, the best validation score,
and the time budget and time remaining.
discovered_tools.name: status

limitations: Successful public result payload schema was observed for the untouched starter in one fresh task container; ungraded queued/grading result payloads were observed only through the status strings, not fully validated.
grader_output_tail is returned by the public endpoint but is not saved into the contract or forwarded to BananLoop roles.
This is one public baseline protocol probe, not a BananLoop result and not an independently approved EvaluatorProtocolV1.

observed_public_status_shape.best: null or task-specific public validation summary
